review_method: Codex visually inspected all four final rendered pages and read the argument and source qualifications; this is not human acceptance.
confirmed_checks: Readable headings, equation terms and interpretation; source footnotes are visible.
One compact comparison table fits within margins.
No clipped text, overlapping content or build errors observed.
Corrected a one-line continuation by enforcing widow and club penalties, then inspected every rebuilt page.
Original source PDFs, original reader and original monograph/companion PDFs are separate and unchanged.
semantic_review: Positive results are bounded clause and engineering checks. Unknown facts, missing sources and pending independent legal review remain explicit. The addendum adds an interpreted boolean relation without altering the original manuscript.
